key.name: result-mode
key.summary: What to copy to the clipboard
key.description: auto: the decoded QR/barcode payloads (one per line) if any were found, otherwise the OCR text. codes: only QR/barcode payloads. text: only OCR text. both: payloads, a blank line, then the OCR text.

key.name: ocr-languages
key.description: Tesseract language codes joined with "+", e.g. "eng+fin". Each needs its Fedora package, e.g. tesseract-langpack-fin.

key.name: show-notifications
key.summary: Show a notification after each scan
key.description: Error notifications (missing software, failed scans) are always shown.
